key_note: The Darkin Blade (Q) is most of his damage and healing: its three swings each hit a different area, so stepping out of them wins trades. Infernal Chains (W) drags you back if you stay in its area.
ult_note: World Ender gives him attack damage, more healing and Move Speed, and takedowns extend it. While it's up he's very hard to kill in long fights; options are to disengage until it ends, or burst him before he heals back up.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6 with World Ender; strongest in the mid game once a couple of items are done, when his healing wins extended fights.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text. airborne from the Q edge knock-up (not in the short text). cc 1 not 2: Q knock-up and W pull are both dodgeable. jungle style uncertain

key_note: E (charm) is her only CC; once it's down she can't catch you. R makes her hard to gank after 6.
ult_note: R (Spirit Rush) gives her up to three dashes, with more after takedowns, so she can dive a target, chase, or slip out of a gank. While it's down she is much easier to catch, so tracking when she used it gives a window to gank or all-in.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6 when Spirit Rush lets her roam and pick off targets safely; stronger again once her first damage item is done.
notes: roam, waveclear, frontline, ult_note, spike_note drafted by llm from 16.19.1

key_note: W (Twilight Shroud) makes her invisible and untargetable inside the smoke and is her main way out of trades. She is easiest to punish right after she has used it.
ult_note: R (Perfect Execution) is two dashes: a leap that damages, then a re-cast dash that executes enemies she strikes. It lets her reach squishy carries and clean up low targets; staying near tanks and holding crowd control for her second dash makes it harder for her to get out.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6 when R gives her two more dashes; dangerous once her first damage item is done, and a real threat to any squishy target with a couple of items.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; engage 1 not 2: E (Shuriken Flip) is a single-target dive, not a team engage

key_note: Q (Avengerang) and his passive's extra shot win short trades. E (Heroic Swing) needs terrain and he is knocked off if he hits a champion or wall, so fighting away from walls or body-blocking the swing limits it.
ult_note: R (Comeuppance) locks onto one champion, stores bullets, then fires them at the first champion, minion or structure in the way, dealing more the lower the target's health. It finishes low targets from range; a minion or teammate in the line can block it. His W (Going Rogue) can revive allies if he kills their killer.
spike_note: Trades well from the start thanks to his passive; big jump at level 6 when R can finish fleeing targets, and stronger again once a couple of damage items are done.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; roam 2 not 3 (W camouflage helps roams, but unsure it is core); waveclear 1 not 2

key_note: W-Q combo knocks up but he has to walk up to do it. Don't dump damage into his R.
ult_note: R (Unbreakable Will) removes all crowd control on him and cuts the damage he takes, so he can dive deep and live. Damage into him while it's up is mostly wasted; backing off, peeling the carry he jumps on, or hitting someone else until it ends all work better.
spike_note: Level 2 gives him the W-Q combo, his main kill threat in lane. After that he is about setup rather than damage, and gets tankier with each defensive item.
notes: roam, waveclear, frontline, ult_note, spike_note drafted by llm from 16.19.1

key_note: Every ability comes with a short dash from her passive (Drakehound's Step), and W (Repudiation) hits harder if she blocks your damage while bracing. Don't trade into her W; trade once her dashes and energy are spent.
ult_note: R (Public Execution) blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line and suppresses, then stuns them, so backliners are its usual target. Standing behind your frontline doesn't protect you; keep spacing wide and keep peel nearby when it's up.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6, when R adds a long-reach pick tool. Dangerous again once her first damage item is done.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; early 2 not 3 (strong skirmisher but unsure she wins most lanes); style ganker is a guess (no hard CC before 6, strong ganks after)

key_note: Q (Bandage Toss) opens his ganks; a miss usually ends the gank.
ult_note: R (Curse of the Sad Mummy) stuns every enemy around him at once, so after level 6 he can start a whole teamfight from fog or off a Q (Bandage Toss) hit. Spreading out and watching his angle limit how many he catches; fighting while it's down is an option.
spike_note: Ganks get much more dangerous at level 6 when R follows Q; he gets tankier and more reliable in fights after a couple of tank items.
notes: roam, waveclear, frontline, ult_note, spike_note drafted by llm from 16.19.1

key_note: Flash Frost (Q) is her stun and doubles Frostbite's damage; it's slow, so sidestep it and trade while it's down. Rebirth turns her into an egg on a fatal hit, so a kill needs enough damage left to break it.
ult_note: Glacial Storm makes an area that damages and slows, and a fully formed storm doubles Frostbite's damage. It clears waves fast and zones chokes and sieges; options are to fight outside it, and remember its cooldown is very short.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6 when Glacial Storm lets her clear waves and zone fights; she gets steadily stronger with items and is at her best late.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text. scaling 2 or 3, picked lower. waveclear weak before 6, fast after

key_note: Passive (Pyromania): after four spells her next damaging spell stuns, and she starts the game with it ready. Trading when the stun isn't charged and backing off when it is takes away most of her kill pressure; she has no dash.
ult_note: R (Summon: Tibbers) bursts an area and leaves a bear that keeps attacking and burning nearby enemies. With a stun charged it can start a teamfight on several grouped targets from out of vision; spreading out and watching her stun charge limit it.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6 when Tibbers plus a charged stun can burst a target from range; dangerous again once her first damage item is done.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; cc 2 not 3: the point-and-click stun only comes after four spells

key_note: His Q changes with his main-hand gun: Gravitum roots anyone it has slowed, Calibrum pokes from long range. He has no dash, so engaging when he holds weaker guns and his support is away is the best window.
ult_note: R (Moonlight Vigil) fires a blast that explodes on enemy champions and applies his main-hand gun's effect to everyone it hits. It is strongest against a grouped team; spreading out and noting which gun he holds before a fight limits it.
spike_note: Weak in the first levels; level 6 adds a strong team fight blast. He becomes a main carry as items come in and is at his best with a couple of items.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; cc and waveclear depend on which gun he holds, scored low

key_note: No dash. Her R arrow is her only real engage; if it misses, punish.
ult_note: R (Enchanted Crystal Arrow) flies in a long straight line and stuns the first champion it hits, longer the farther it traveled, and slows enemies around them. It only stops on champions, so minions don't block it; it can start a fight from far away or catch someone in another lane.
spike_note: Level 6 gives her a long-range engage stun; otherwise she grows steadily with items rather than spiking hard early.
notes: roam, waveclear, frontline, ult_note, spike_note drafted by llm from 16.19.1

key_note: Q (Breath of Light) has to stay on you to ramp up, and W (Astral Flight) is his only escape. Stepping out of the beam beats his trades; ganks work best right after W is used.
ult_note: R (Falling Star) is an area stun that can start or turn a fight. With enough Stardust it becomes The Skies Descend: a bigger knock-up plus a slowing shockwave. Spreading out before fights limits how many it catches.
spike_note: Level 6 adds a stun to his all-in. Stardust makes every ability stronger the longer the game goes, so pressuring him early and denying his fights matters.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; cc 1 for the slow pull of E (Singularity); airborne only on The Skies Descend; roam 0 or 1, chose 1

key_note: W (Across the Veil) is her main escape: a leap that makes her invisible with bonus speed, and E (The Weirding) also hops her backward. She has only slows before 6; trade or gank when W is down.
ult_note: R (Between Worlds) leaps in, slows everyone hit, then leaves a zone that slows enemies inside while she teleports from side to side. Fighting inside the zone favors her; walk out of it rather than chasing her through it.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6. Strong again once her first damage item is done.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; passive heals her in lane (sustain tag left off, judge on review)

key_note: W (Arise!) soldiers do his damage at range, and E (Shifting Sands) dashes to them; once E is used he has no escape, which is a window to trade or gank. Q (Conquering Sands) only slows.
ult_note: R (Emperor's Divide) sends a wall of soldiers that knocks enemies back. He can dash in with E and Q first to push a carry into his team, or use it to stop a dive. Keeping distance from him when R is up, and fighting after he uses it, are options.
spike_note: Weak to ganks before level 6; much stronger once his first damage item is done, and he keeps scaling into the late game.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; early 1 vs 2 and scaling 2 vs 3 were close

key_note: Cosmic Binding (Q) only stuns if it carries on into a wall or another unit, so avoid standing in front of walls or with minions lined up behind you. When it misses he has little kill pressure.
ult_note: Tempered Fate puts everything in an area into stasis, allies, monsters and turrets included. He uses it to freeze a group for an engage, stop a dive or save an ally, and it can arrive from far away; options are to spread out and not walk into it.
spike_note: Strong at level 6 with Tempered Fate; he also grows all game by collecting chimes, so a Bard left free to roam gets stronger without kills.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text. cc 2: Q stun is conditional but long. ult_engage because R often sets up engages

key_note: Q (Void Surge) dashes are how she sticks to targets and escapes, and W (Above and Below) is her only hard CC. Fighting her after W is used, and early before her attack speed stacks build, gives her the least value.
ult_note: R (Endless Banquet) eats the Void coral left by takedowns to transform, gaining max health, range and attack speed, so won fights snowball. Taking a Void epic monster lets her summon Void remora to push; contesting those objectives and avoiding long skirmishes limit her.
spike_note: Weak early; strong from level 6 when she can transform after takedowns, and keeps growing as permanent attack speed stacks and a couple of items come together.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; engage 2 from Q dash plus W knock-up, could be 1

key_note: Q (Rocket Grab) is the whole threat: a hit drags you into E (Power Fist) and his carry. Standing behind your minions makes it hard to land, and its long cooldown after a miss is the window to trade.
ult_note: R (Static Field) removes nearby enemies' shields, damages them and silences them briefly, which stops channels and shield-based saves in a fight. Not grouping tightly around him after a grab limits how many it hits.
spike_note: Level 2 adds the grab into knock-up combo, and level 6 adds a silence. He is about picks more than items and loses impact as enemies stay grouped and get tankier.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text

key_note: Q (Sear) only stuns targets already ablaze, so he lands E (Conflagration) or W (Pillar of Flame) first. Dodging the delayed W helps, and when Blaze maxes on you it explodes after 2 seconds, so stepping away from allies limits it.
ult_note: R (Pyroclasm) bounces up to 5 times between Brand and nearby enemies, stacking Blaze to max on champions, which sets off area explosions. It shreds grouped teams; spreading out in fights and not standing next to allies when he has R up cuts the damage a lot.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6 when R turns his combo into a teamfight threat; a first damage item makes his burst lethal on squishy targets.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; cc 1 not 2 because the Q stun needs the target ablaze first; waveclear 2 not 3

key_note: Passive (Concussive Blows) stuns at 4 stacks shared with his carry, usually opened by Q (Winter's Bite). Dodging Q avoids the stun; skillshots land better once E (Unbreakable) is down, since it eats projectiles.
ult_note: R (Glacial Fissure) knocks up enemies around him and in a line, then leaves a slowing fissure. It's mostly a peel and disengage tool that stops dives on his carry; baiting it out or going around the fissure works better than diving through it.
spike_note: Strong from early levels when his carry can stack the passive; level 6 adds a knock-up for peel. Gets tankier with each defensive item rather than more dangerous.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; escape 1 because W (Stand Behind Me) needs an ally or minion to jump to

key_note: Q (Head Rush) is a targeted leap that stuns. W (Blood Frenzy) makes her chase the nearest enemy, so she can be kited into your team or tower. She has no natural Health Regeneration, so damage before a fight sticks.
ult_note: R (Certain Death) marks the first champion the gem hits; she beelines to them, fears enemies nearby on arrival and chases that target to the death with extra resistances and life steal. A tanky ally standing in front can catch it instead of a carry.
spike_note: Strong from level 3 once she has all three basic abilities, then a big jump at level 6 when R lets her start fights from a distance.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; invade_strong left off (unsure); E full charge knockback counted as airborne

key_note: E (net) is her escape. Bait it before committing.
ult_note: R (Ace in the Hole) is a long-range shot on one target after a short wind-up; it finishes anyone left low after a fight or walking back to lane. An ally stepping into the bullet blocks it, so staying healthy or near teammates makes it less of a threat.
spike_note: Pressures from long range early; her damage jumps once her first couple of crit items are done.
notes: roam, waveclear, frontline, ult_note, spike_note drafted by llm from 16.19.1

key_note: Hookshot (E) is her engage and her escape, and it needs a wall to latch onto; fight away from walls, or trade back hard once she's used it. Her passive shield makes short trades into her poor.
ult_note: The Hextech Ultimatum dashes her to one champion and anchors them in the area, so they can't walk away and allies can't easily help. She uses it to pick off carries; options are to stay near teammates who can peel, or save a dash for when she commits.
spike_note: Strong at level 6 when she can lock down a target; much more dangerous with her first item and a strong side-lane duelist after a couple.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text. text says E knocks up (airborne). roam 1 or 2, picked lower

key_note: Q (Noxious Blast) poisons you, and E (Twin Fang) hits poisoned targets much harder and heals her. Dodging Q, or trading while it's down, takes away most of her pressure; W (Miasma) grounds, so dashes through it are blocked.
ult_note: R (Petrifying Gaze) stuns everyone in front of her who is facing her and only slows those turned away. It punishes head-on dives and all-ins; approaching from the side, or facing away as she casts, turns the stun into a slow.
spike_note: Strong from level 6 when the stun covers all-ins; keeps scaling with levels and a couple of items and is very strong late.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; cc 1 because W grounds and slows but isn't hard CC; passive text differs from older kits, so no claims about boots

key_note: Q (Rupture) knock-up is slow to land. Dodge it and he has little else.
ult_note: R (Feast) deals heavy true damage to one target, and each kill makes him bigger with more max Health. It executes low-health champions and can also secure big monsters; staying healthy when he is near keeps you out of its reach.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6 with Feast; he keeps scaling as Feast stacks build, becoming a huge tank late in the game.
notes: roam, waveclear, frontline, ult_note, spike_note drafted by llm from 16.19.1

key_note: W (Valkyrie) is his only dash; once it is on cooldown he is much easier to catch. E (Gatling Gun) lowers your armor and magic resist, so long trades in front of him cost a lot.
ult_note: R (Missile Barrage) stores missiles over time and fires them at range, with every 3rd being a Big One. It is steady poke rather than a fight-starter; it explodes on the first enemy hit, so minions can catch it, and long fights at range favor him.
spike_note: Medium early; level 6 adds steady missile poke, and he gets much stronger once his first damage item is done and again with a couple of items.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; text has no mention of his package, so roam kept at 1

key_note: Never fight him at 5 bleed stacks. E pull is his only gap-close; once it's down, kite.
ult_note: R (Noxian Guillotine) leaps to a champion for true damage that grows with bleed stacks, and refreshes on a kill, so he can chain through a whole fight. Keeping his stacks low and kiting him before he reaches the backline limits it.
spike_note: Level 3 gives him his full all-in; level 6 adds an execute. His first damage item makes him very hard to fight in lane.
notes: roam, waveclear, frontline, ult_note, spike_note drafted by llm from 16.19.1

key_note: Q (Crescent Strike) marks you with Moonlight, and E (Lunar Rush) has no cooldown on a Moonlit target, so a landed Q means two dashes. Dodge Q and her E is on a long cooldown; trade then.
ult_note: R (Moonfall) pulls in and slows everyone nearby, then hits harder for each extra champion pulled. Spread out when she can dive with R up; one target hit takes the least damage.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6, when R makes her ganks and dives deadly. Stronger again once her first damage item is done.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; roam 1 not 2 for mid (roams well after 6, less before)

key_note: Q (Infected Bonesaw) is his poke and slow and hits the first enemy, so minions block it. His passive (Goes Where He Pleases) shrugs off the first stun or root, so ganks need a second piece of CC.
ult_note: R (Maximum Dosage) heals a big part of his missing health, then keeps healing him with extra move speed for a long time, so he is very hard to kill while it's up. Bursting him before he casts it, waiting it out, or ignoring him to hit his carries are options.
spike_note: Level 6 makes him hard to kill in lane; after a couple of health items he is a tank who still hits hard, since E (Blunt Force Trauma) scales with his max health.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; scaling 2 vs 3 was close, picked lower; roam 0 assumes top, jungle Mundo ganks a little better

key_note: Spinning Axe (Q) needs him to catch his axes; forcing him to move away from where they land, or zoning that spot, cuts his damage and his Blood Rush resets. He's strongest when he keeps catching.
ult_note: Whirling Death sends two axes across the map that turn back after hitting a champion, so it can hit twice and finish low targets in any lane. It executes anyone below his Adoration stacks; options are to play safer when low, even far from him.
spike_note: Strongest from levels 1-3 and again at level 6; his kills give extra gold through Adoration, so an early lead snowballs fast. Denying early kills keeps him manageable.

key_note: E (Phase Dive) is his gap-closer and his only escape before level 6. W (Parallel Convergence) stuns only after a delay and only if he steps into the zone, so leaving the zone early or baiting E first makes trades safer.
ult_note: R (Chronobreak) makes him untargetable and rewinds him to where he was a few seconds ago, healing and dealing heavy damage around that spot. Staying away from where he just stood avoids the burst, and he is much easier to kill once it is down.
spike_note: Gets dangerous at level 6 when Chronobreak lets him dive and get out again; much stronger once his first damage item is done.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; cc 1 because the W stun is delayed and needs setup; style farmer vs ganker is a toss-up

key_note: Human E (cocoon) is her catch. If it misses, the gank usually fails.
ult_note: R (Spider Form) swaps her between ranged human form and melee spider form, each with its own abilities, and she has it from the start, so level 6 changes less for her than for most. Spider E (Rappel) lifts her into the air to drop onto a target or dodge a key spell.
spike_note: Strongest early: level 3 with all her abilities is her big gank spike. She falls off if the early game doesn't go her way and is weaker late than most junglers.

key_note: Weak before level 6 with no camouflage yet, so contesting or invading her early is an option. W (Allure) only charms if she hits you after its delay, so walking out of range while it is primed avoids the charm.
ult_note: R (Last Caress) makes her briefly untargetable, hits an area in front of her hard, then warps her far backwards, so she can finish a target and escape at once. After level 6 her passive also gives camouflage, so lanes without vision are at risk of surprise ganks.
spike_note: Weak before level 6; at level 6 she gains camouflage and R and her ganks get very dangerous, more so once her first damage item is done.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; escape 2 not 3 (R untargetable but only one tool); roam 1 because her ganks come after level 6; farmer before 6, ganker after

key_note: E (Arcane Shift) is his only escape. Gank right after he uses it.
ult_note: R (Trueshot Barrage) is a very long-range line of damage that can finish low-health champions in other lanes or hit several enemies in a fight. It has a wind-up, so side-stepping works; staying low on health in his line is the risk.
spike_note: His power comes from items more than levels: weakest before his first couple of items, and steadily stronger as he completes them.
notes: roam, waveclear, frontline, ult_note, spike_note drafted by llm from 16.19.1

key_note: Q (Terrify) is a targeted fear, and his spells also fear you when he hits you while unseen. E (Reap) silences in its center. He has no dash; ward brushes and fight him once Q is down.
ult_note: R (Crowstorm) surrounds him with crows that damage every enemy nearby each second, so it punishes grouped teams. It's worst when he arrives unseen; vision on brushes and fog near objectives is the main counter, and spreading out limits it.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6, when R makes his ganks and objective fights dangerous. Much stronger once a couple of items are done.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; early 1 not 2 (ganks with fear but weak duels)

key_note: W (Riposte) parries all damage and stuns if it blocks a stun or root, so holding CC until after she uses it is the safer option. Q (Lunge) onto her Vitals heals her, so short trades favor her.
ult_note: R (Grand Challenge) reveals all four Vitals on one champion; if she hits them all or the target dies, she and nearby allies heal. Few champions beat her alone once it's up. Meeting her with a teammate, or using CC to stop her reaching Vitals, are options.
spike_note: Level 6 lets her win most trades outright; with her first damage item she wins most one-on-ones and becomes a strong split pusher.

key_note: Playful / Trickster (E) makes him untargetable and is his only way to dodge; bait it out, then trade or gank while it's on cooldown. Without it he can't get out after diving in with Urchin Strike (Q).
ult_note: Chum the Waters throws a fish that sticks to the first champion it touches; after a short delay a shark knocks them up and knocks nearby enemies aside. It picks off squishy carries from range; options are to dodge the fish or move away from a tagged ally.
spike_note: Threatening from level 3 with all his basic abilities and much more at level 6; with his first damage item he can burst most squishy targets.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text. cc 0: only slows before 6. engage 1: Q dash can start a skirmish, no hard CC

key_note: E (Justice Punch) is his gap-closer and knock-up; once it misses or is on cooldown he has little way to reach you. W (Shield of Durand) taunts around him, so staying outside its radius while he charges it avoids the taunt.
ult_note: R (Hero's Entrance) flies him to an ally after a delay, shielding allies there and knocking up enemies when he lands. After level 6, dives and skirmishes near any ally can turn; checking where he is and whether R is up before committing helps.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6 when his ult lets him join fights in other lanes; stronger once his first item adds magic damage or durability.

ult_note: R (Cannon Barrage) bombards an area anywhere on the map, slowing and damaging, so he can help a fight or finish a low target in another lane. From level 6 expect it in any fight; leaving the barrage area quickly limits it.
spike_note: Weak in the first levels and wants to farm; level 6 adds map-wide help, and he becomes a big threat with a couple of damage items and a strong late game.

key_note: No hard CC, but Q removes slows. Gank him with hard CC, not slows.
ult_note: R (Demacian Justice) is a point-and-click execute on one enemy champion, so it can't be dodged; staying out of his reach when low is the main answer. In fights he looks for whoever is lowest, so low carries should keep their distance.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6 when R lets him finish low targets; he grows tankier as W (Courage) stacks from kills and keeps scaling steadily with items.

key_note: Watch his Rage bar: when full, his next ability turns him into Mega Gnar, with a stun (Wallop) and more durability. Trading while he is small, or after he shrinks back, is safer; missing Q (Boomerang Throw) costs him.

spike_note: Level 6 makes every Mega transform a team fight threat. His ultimate's cooldown drops a lot as it ranks up, so his big fights come more often later.

key_note: E (Body Slam) is his engage and his escape: a charge that stuns the first enemy unit it hits. Minions block it, so stand behind your wave; once E is down he can't reach you.
ult_note: R (Explosive Cask) knocks enemies away from the blast, so he can throw one of you into his team or split a dive apart. Diving him with R up is risky; bait it out first.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6, when R adds a pick or peel tool. Gets tankier and harder to kill as his items come in.

key_note: E (Quickdraw) is his only dash and gives him resistances; once it's used he is easy to catch. His shotgun must reload when out of ammo and bullets stop at the first unit, so fighting behind minions or right after he empties it are options.
ult_note: R (Collateral Damage) hits the first champion for heavy damage, then explodes in a cone behind them. It finishes low targets and punishes teams standing in a line. Spreading out and not standing behind a teammate he is shooting limit it.
spike_note: A strong early skirmisher who farms fast; level 6 adds burst, and his first damage item makes him a serious duelist.

key_note: Hallowed Mist (W) blocks damage from anyone outside it, so step into the mist to hit her or back off until it ends. Snip Snip! (Q) deals true damage in the center of its cone, so avoid standing right in front of her.
ult_note: Needlework can be cast three times, each throwing more needles that slow and apply A Thousand Cuts. It helps her stick to targets from range; options are to keep spacing so she can't follow with Skip 'n Slash (E), or burst her before the later casts.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6 with Needlework; she scales well with items, and her damage based on target health makes her strong against tanks later.

key_note: E (Devastating Charge) builds speed and his next hit knocks you back, harder the farther he ran; it's his main gank tool. Vision on his approach and keeping distance until E is used make his ganks much weaker.
ult_note: R (Onslaught of Shadows) charges forward in a line and makes nearby enemies flee in terror where he lands, so he can engage a whole team or start ganks from far away. Spreading out limits the fear, and staying near allies who can peel him helps.
spike_note: Strong from level 6 when the fear makes ganks and engages reliable; much stronger once his first item adds damage and speed.

key_note: His Q turrets control the lane and punish fighting near them; E (Electron Storm Grenade) stuns anyone it hits directly. Fighting away from his turrets, or ganking from an angle they can't cover, works best.
ult_note: R (UPGRADE!!!) makes his next spell much stronger: a bigger turret, a heavier rocket volley, or a larger grenade. It makes the area around him very dangerous; fighting away from him or right after he spends it is safer.
spike_note: Strong early in lane thanks to his turrets, with a jump at level 6. He is best at holding and sieging an area and gets weaker when enemies group and dive him.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; engage 1: E stun can start a fight but he is immobile

key_note: His crowd control sits in E (Subject: Torment): one of Grim Visage, Gaze of the Abyss or Crushing Maw per cast. Once that is used he has little to stop an all-in; Q (Subject: Disaster) is long-range poke.
ult_note: R (Spiraling Despair) sticks to the first enemy champion hit and grows into a painting that slows and damages everyone near them before exploding. The marked champion moving away from teammates keeps the zone from catching the whole team.
spike_note: Strong poke from the early levels; level 6 adds a teamfight zone, and his damage grows a lot once his first item is done.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; cc 2 not 3 since he gets one Torment spell per cast and the text names the sub-spells without detail

key_note: E (Test of Spirit) pulls your spirit out and makes you a tentacle target; fighting her next to it is a losing trade. When E misses or is on cooldown she is much easier to trade into, and open space means fewer tentacles.
ult_note: R (Leap of Faith) hits everyone around her and spawns a tentacle for each champion hit, so diving her as a group near walls feeds her. Fighting her in open space, or backing off until the tentacles fade, takes away most of its power.
spike_note: Level 6 makes her very hard to fight around walls. With a couple of items she becomes a dangerous side-lane split-pusher who wins most one-on-ones.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; engage 1 for the short leap of W (Harsh Lesson)

key_note: Q (Bladesurge) resets when it kills a unit or hits a Marked target, so she chains dashes through low minions. E (Flawless Duet) stuns and Marks. Dodge E and fight her when your wave is healthy.
ult_note: R (Vanguard's Edge) Marks everyone it hits, letting her Q dash between them freely, then leaves a blade wall that damages and slows. It's her engage into a group; spread out and don't walk through the wall.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6 and again with her first damage item; at full passive stacks she wins long trades.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; waveclear 1 not 2 (Q waveclear relies on last hits)

key_note: Q (Rootcaller) roots the first enemy and lets his allies dash to them; it is his gank. Dodging it leaves him with little damage, and invading him is an option since he can't attack normal jungle monsters.
ult_note: R (Daisy!) summons Daisy, a sentinel who fights with him and can be told to attack or move. She adds a frontline and extra damage to ganks and fights. Killing Daisy first, or fighting him before level 6, are options.
spike_note: Weak alone at every stage; level 6 adds Daisy to his ganks and fights, and he gets stronger as his own carries get items.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; waveclear 0 vs 1 was close, picked lower; style ganker because Q is a strong gank tool and his clear does not fight camps

key_note: Howling Gale (Q) is her knock-up and travels in a straight line, so sidestep it before committing. Eye Of The Storm (E) shields her lane partner, so trades go better while it's on cooldown.
ult_note: Monsoon throws every nearby enemy away from her, then heals her allies while it's active. It stops dives and all-ins; options are to bait it before the real engage, or engage from an angle where pushing you back doesn't help her team.
spike_note: Her kit is about peel more than damage; Monsoon at level 6 is the main jump, and she grows with items that boost her shields and heals.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text

key_note: E then Q (Demacian Standard into Dragon Strike) is his gap-closer and knock-up, and the flag has to land first. Once the combo is on cooldown he has little way to reach you; dodging the line between him and the flag avoids the knock-up.
ult_note: R (Cataclysm) leaps onto a target and walls them in with terrain, trapping them and anyone nearby with him. It's a strong engage onto a carry; keeping a dash or Flash to get over the wall, or spreading so it traps fewer people, limits it.
spike_note: Strong from level 3 once he has the E-Q combo for ganks, and at level 6 when Cataclysm locks a target down; falls off later if he isn't ahead.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; early 2, could be 3 for gank pressure

key_note: E (Counter Strike) dodges basic attacks for a short time and then stuns around him, so trading into it with attacks is wasted. Backing off until it ends, or trading right after it's used, works best.
ult_note: R (Grandmaster-at-Arms) adds damage to every third hit, and when activated damages around him and raises his Armor and Magic Resist for a short time. It makes him a strong duelist and side-lane threat; fighting him alone while it's up is risky.
spike_note: Solid early with a jump at level 6; he gets much stronger with each item and is one of the best late-game duelists, so letting him farm freely is risky.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; frontline 1 not 2: bruiser, tanky only with R active

key_note: Cannon Q (Shock Blast), boosted through E (Acceleration Gate), is his poke and detonates on the first enemy hit, so minions block it. Hammer E (Thundering Blow) knocks back, so fighting with your back to his tower is risky.
ult_note: R (Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer) is not a big ultimate: it swaps between ranged and melee stances, giving him two sets of abilities. He threatens through poke and burst rather than one fight-changing button, so quick all-ins on him tend to favor you.
spike_note: Has his full kit in both stances by level 3; strongest around his first damage item, and tends to fall off late compared to scaling champions.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; no level 6 spike since R is a stance swap; frontline 0 not 1

key_note: No dash. Easiest bot laner to gank. Stay out of range when his 4th shot is loaded.
ult_note: R (Curtain Call) fires 4 very long-range shots that slow and execute, and the last one always crits. It reaches well beyond his lane and finishes fleeing targets, but he channels it in place, so a flank or dive can catch him.
spike_note: Level 2 gives him a root with W (Deadly Flourish) after a hit; level 6 adds long-range execute. Each crit item makes his 4th shot hit much harder.
notes: roam, waveclear, frontline, ult_note, spike_note drafted by llm from 16.19.1

key_note: No dash. Her passive gives big speed after a takedown, so don't let her reset fights. Weak early, a monster late.
ult_note: R (Super Mega Death Rocket!) flies across the map, gains damage as it travels and hits harder on low-health targets. Anyone low in any lane is at risk; recall instead of staying low after a fight.
spike_note: No big early level spike; she comes online once a couple of damage items are done and is a monster late.
notes: roam, waveclear, frontline, ult_note, spike_note drafted by llm from 16.19.1

key_note: W (Path Maker) charges up, then dashes to knock back and stun; backing off or dodging the dash are options. With two stacks, Q (Ntofo Strikes) fires a shockwave that pulls, so staying out of range then is safer.
ult_note: R (All Out) knocks one enemy back, through any wall in the way, and he dashes after them with more damage and healing but lower defenses. It cuts a carry off from their team. Staying away from walls near him and focusing him while All Out are options.
spike_note: Level 6 lets him isolate one target; after a couple of tank items he is a hard-to-kill frontline who still threatens a pick with R.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; early 1 vs 2 was close, picked lower; cc 3 because Q pull and W stun are two hard CCs before 6

key_note: Icathian Rain (Q) seeks out nearby targets, so it hits much harder when you're alone; staying near your minions blunts her trades. She has no dash before level 6, so she's gankable early.
ult_note: Killer Instinct dashes her near an enemy champion, usually one marked by her passive after her team's CC or her Void Seeker (W) lands. It lets her dive backliners; options are to avoid getting marked and keep peel near carries.
spike_note: Her item purchases upgrade her basic abilities, so each upgrade is a jump; level 6 adds a dash, and she's strongest once a few items are done.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text. early 1 or 2, picked lower. scaling 2 or 3, picked lower. R needing a passive mark is knowledge, not in the short text

key_note: E (Rend) stacks spears with every hit, and ripping them out slows and deals growing damage. Short trades and walking away before many spears build keep her E weak; she has no hard CC and her hops are short.
ult_note: R (Fate's Call) pulls her bound ally to her, and they can then dash and knock enemy champions back. It saves a dived ally or turns a melee support into an engage from range; checking whether it's up before diving bot lane helps.
spike_note: Strong at level 2 with her support and again at level 6 when Fate's Call adds an engage or a save; falls off later, so she wants to win early.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; early 3 as a lane bully, could be 2

key_note: Q (Inner Flame) is her poke, much stronger with R (Mantra). W (Focused Resolve) roots only if you stay in the tether, so walking out of range breaks it. Trading right after she spends Mantra is safest.
ult_note: R (Mantra) is available at level 1 and empowers her next ability: bigger Q poke, a longer W root with healing, or a team-wide shield and speed from E. It makes her strong in lane and in fights; the moment after she spends it is the best time to go in.
spike_note: Strong from level 1 because Mantra needs no skill point; she bullies lanes early, has no big jump at level 6, and turns into more of a utility pick later.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; spikes 1 because Mantra is up from level 1; engage 1 and cc 1: W root is delayed and can be walked out of

key_note: Farms early. After 6 his global R can finish anyone low in any lane.
ult_note: R (Requiem) hits every enemy champion after a 3 second channel, so anyone low in any lane can be finished from anywhere. Backing or healing when low after a fight blunts it, and his passive lets him keep casting for a while after he dies.
spike_note: Weak early while he farms; level 6 adds map-wide R, and he becomes a major teamfight threat after a couple of items.
notes: roam, waveclear, frontline, ult_note, spike_note drafted by llm from 16.19.1

key_note: Before level 6 he has no dash and short range, so short trades and pressure on his farm slow him down. Q (Null Sphere) gives him a magic shield, which weakens trades for magic damage dealers.
ult_note: R (Riftwalk) is a short-cooldown blink that hits harder when chained, letting him jump onto backliners, dodge, and escape. Its cooldown shrinks with each rank; hard CC held for him, or a guard near the carry, is the main answer.
spike_note: Weak before level 6, then level 6 gives him his blink. Level 16 is his biggest jump, when Riftwalk is up almost nonstop; the window to punish him is before then.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; roam 1 or 2, chose 1 since he roams mainly after level 6

key_note: Her damage comes from daggers on the ground: picking one up slashes everyone nearby. Stay away from where her daggers land, and trade when E (Shunpo) is down since it's her only gap-closer.
ult_note: R (Death Lotus) is a channel that hits the 3 nearest enemy champions with heavy magic damage. Hard CC stops it, so save a stun or knock-up for when she blinks in; each takedown cuts her cooldowns and lets her reset through a fight.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6, when R makes roams and all-ins deadly. Very dangerous once her first item is done and she starts chaining takedowns.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; early 1 not 2 (weak lane before 6 against ranged); escape 3 for takedown resets

key_note: She is melee and very weak before level 6, and her passive (Divine Ascent) only adds range as she levels, so trading often and denying farm early are options. Q (Radiant Blast) slows and lowers resists.
ult_note: R (Divine Judgment) makes one ally invulnerable and rains swords around her target; it can save a carry from a dive or burst. Baiting it out before going for the kill, or waiting it out, are options.
spike_note: Very weak before level 6; she jumps at levels 6, 11 and 16 as her passive grows, and becomes a late-game carry with a few items.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; early 0 vs 1 was close, picked lower

key_note: Shadow Step (E) lets him walk through terrain, so he ganks from unusual angles; ward walls near your lane, not just the paths. Before his form, Blade's Reach (W) is his only slow, so he's weak in early skirmishes.
ult_note: Umbral Trespass hides him inside an enemy he recently damaged, then he bursts out for heavy damage. It lets him dodge damage mid-fight and finish low targets; options are to burst him before he can use it, and expect him to appear wherever his target is.
spike_note: Weak until his passive lets him become Darkin or Shadow Assassin, usually in the mid game; level 6 adds Umbral Trespass, and he's dangerous once transformed with items.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text. cc 0: W is a slow in base form (Darkin form knock-up not in the text). style farmer: needs fights for his form

key_note: Q (Thundering Shuriken) is his poke and the easiest way to stack Mark of the Storm, which stuns at three marks. Standing behind minions blocks Q, and backing off when you have two marks avoids the stun.
ult_note: R (Slicing Maelstrom) strikes every nearby enemy champion repeatedly, and his ability hits stack marks into stuns, so running into a team with it can stun several people. Spreading out and watching for E (Lightning Rush) or Flash into your team limit it.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6 when Slicing Maelstrom gives him an area stun for teamfights; much stronger once his first damage item is done.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text

key_note: Q (Taste Their Fear) hits much harder on isolated targets with no allies nearby. Staying near minions or teammates cuts his damage a lot, and E (Leap) is his main way in and out, so fights go better once it's used.
ult_note: R (Void Assault) makes him invisible with extra speed, and each rank evolves one ability: longer Q range, three W spikes that slow and reveal, E (Leap) gaining 200 range and resets on takedowns, or more invisibility. Isolated targets are his prey; grouping and vision limit him.
spike_note: Each evolution at levels 6, 11 and 16 is a jump; once his first damage item is done, isolated squishy targets die quickly.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; escape 2 not 3: becomes 3 with evolved E or R

key_note: Q (Dance of Arrows) is her only dash and E (Mounting Dread) only slows, so hard CC catches her. Her passive rewards completing Hunts on marked camps and champions; denying those marks slows her scaling.
ult_note: R (Lamb's Respite) makes a zone where nothing can die until it ends, then heals units inside, for both teams. It can save a dying ally or a dive target; backing off until the zone ends instead of spending damage into it is usually the better option.
spike_note: Level 6 adds a fight-saving ult; she grows stronger as she completes Hunts, with every 4 extending her attack range, so falling behind on marks matters.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; scaling 2 not 3 (scales with Hunts, depends on marks); engage 0 not 1

key_note: Q (Bear Trap on a Rope) hooks you and yanks you in after a short time, so dodging it wins most trades. When Skaarl's health runs out Kled dismounts and deals less damage, a good window to fight back.
ult_note: R (Chaaaaaaaarge!!!) sends him on a long charge with a speed trail his allies can follow, and rams the first champion it meets. It starts fights and flanks from far away; vision on his approach and spreading out make it easier to answer.
spike_note: Strong from level 1 and again at level 6 when he can charge into fights from afar. His first damage item makes him a strong duelist; he tends to fall off in long games.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; cc 1 because the Q yank needs the tether to hold; frontline 1 or 2 (Skaarl's health), chose 1

key_note: No dash, so he's one of the easiest targets to gank or dive. W (Bio-Arcane Barrage) gives him extra range and percent health damage while it's up; fight him when W is on cooldown.
ult_note: R (Living Artillery) is long-range artillery that deals much more damage to low-health targets and reveals them. Don't sit low in a fight or at an objective near him; it finishes fleeing targets. Spamming it costs him more Mana.
spike_note: Weak early with little kill pressure; becomes a late-game threat once a couple of attack speed and damage items are done.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text

key_note: W (Distortion) is her engage and her escape, since she can return to her start point; once both parts are used she is easy to punish. Walking out of E (Ethereal Chains) before it roots saves a lot of damage.
ult_note: R (Mimic) recasts one of her basic spells, giving her a second dash, chain or sigil. It doubles her burst on one target and makes her harder to catch. Assuming she has two dashes after level 6, and fighting after she uses R, are options.
spike_note: Dangerous from level 2 with W and Q, much more so at level 6, and strongest once her first damage item is done; she falls off if she gets behind.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; early 2 vs 3 was close, kept 3 since she is an early snowball pick; cc 1 because E only roots after the tether holds

key_note: R kick can knock someone into his team. Strong early, falls off.
ult_note: Dragon's Rage kicks one target back, and enemies they hit are knocked up; the classic play is kicking a carry into his own team. Options are to stay out of positions where a kick sends you into his team, and watch for Safeguard (W) changing his angle.
spike_note: Strongest early: level 3 gives all his basic abilities for ganks and level 6 adds the kick. He falls off in long games, so his team wants an early lead.
notes: roam, waveclear, frontline, ult_note, spike_note drafted by llm from 16.19.1

key_note: E (Zenith Blade) is her only gap-closer. Whiffed E = no engage for a while.
ult_note: R (Solar Flare) calls down a beam on an area at range, stunning enemies in the center and slowing those at the edge. It's often how she starts a fight or catches someone out of position; spreading out limits it, and after it's used she has to walk in with E.
spike_note: Strong at level 2 with Q and E for an all-in, and again at level 6 when Solar Flare adds a ranged stun; stays a durable engager with a couple of tank items.
notes: roam, waveclear, frontline, ult_note, spike_note drafted by llm from 16.19.1

key_note: Q (Blooming Blows) deals extra true damage at its outer edge and builds Move Speed on every spell hit, so she kites well. Standing close in, or fighting where she can't run circles around you, cuts her damage.
ult_note: R (Lilting Lullaby) makes every enemy carrying her Dream Dust drowsy, then puts them to sleep, and they take extra damage when woken. It can catch a whole team once a fight starts; avoiding her spells beforehand and spreading out limit it.
spike_note: A fast clearer with a big jump at level 6, when her ult can sleep several enemies; she gets stronger with each item and does well in long fights.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; engage 1: no hard engage before level 6, only speed and a slow

key_note: E (Glacial Path) is both her engage and escape: she teleports to the claw and follows with W (Ring of Frost) to root. Once E is used she is easier to catch, and staying out of W range blocks her all-in.
ult_note: R (Frozen Tomb) on an enemy is a point-and-click stun that locks down a carry; on herself it makes her untargetable and invulnerable while she heals, then slows everyone nearby. After level 6 she can catch anyone in range, and diving her often meets the self-cast.
spike_note: Level 6 gives her a point-and-click stun, the main jump; a first damage item makes her catch and burst lethal on squishy targets.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; early 1 not 2 (strong all-in but modest kill pressure alone); escape 2 not 3

key_note: E (Ashen Pursuit) is his way in: a teleport, then a dash to his next attack. Trading while it's on cooldown is safer, and his passive (Silver Stake) hits harder the lower your health is, so staying healthy matters.
ult_note: R (Purgatory) throws a binding artifact that damages and can execute enemies hit, and he gains power for each champion he seals away. Low-health allies are most at risk; staying topped up and near peel makes it less deadly.
spike_note: Level 6 adds an execute to finish fights; like most assassins he is most dangerous once his first damage item or two are done.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; new to me: scores from ability text only

key_note: E (Relentless Pursuit) is his only dash, and the double-shot after every ability is what makes his trades hurt. Trade or gank right after E is used; his passive attacks shorten its cooldown.
ult_note: R (The Culling) fires a stream of shots in one direction, strong for finishing a target in lane. It adds damage but little else to team fights; step sideways out of its line rather than running straight away.
spike_note: Strong from level 2 with his support and again at level 6; best through the early and mid game, weaker late.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text; follows_cc from passive bonus vs immobilized enemies

key_note: W polymorph shuts down a dive. Bait it before committing.
ult_note: R (Wild Growth) enlarges an ally, knocks nearby enemies into the air, gives bonus health and slows enemies around them. It stops dives on her carry or helps a diver go in. Diving her carry while it's down, or spreading out, are options.
spike_note: Strong peel from early on; her shields and buffs grow with her items, and she gets more valuable as her carry gets items.
notes: roam, waveclear, frontline, ult_note, spike_note drafted by llm from 16.19.1

key_note: Light Binding (Q) is her root and her main way to start a kill; it stops after two targets, so standing behind your minions blocks it. She has no dash, so after a missed Q she's easy to trade into or gank.
ult_note: Final Spark is a long laser with a short cooldown; it finishes low-health targets from far away and clears waves. Options are to avoid lining up with allies and to respect it when you're low, even when she's out of sight.
spike_note: Big jump at level 6 with Final Spark; her burst grows quickly with her first damage item, and she stays a strong poke and pick threat late.
notes: drafted from 16.19.1 ability text

key_note: R (Unstoppable Force) is an AoE knock-up and basically his whole teamfight. Spread out when it's up.

spike_note: Big jump at level 6 when Unstoppable Force gives him a teamfight engage; very tanky once his first armor item is done, which also raises his E damage.

spike_note: Level 6 gives him a long-range teamfight engage; he gets steadily harder to kill as tank items come in and is strongest in mid-game fights.

key_note: Q (Alpha Strike) makes him untargetable and dodges spells, and his attacks shorten its cooldown. Holding hard CC until after Q, and fighting him early before he farms up, are the best ways to punish him.

spike_note: Weak in early fights; level 6 makes him a real threat to low-health targets. Each damage item makes him much stronger, and with a few he can win fights alone.

key_note: W (Rebuttal) reflects projectiles back and blocks damage, so skillshots thrown into it hurt you. Bait it out first. E (Solar Snare) roots only in its center, so it's the spell to dodge.
ult_note: Her R strikes every enemy marked with Overwhelm no matter how far away, and her passive executes anyone with enough Overwhelm. Any poke from her puts you at risk; avoid staying low after trading with her.

ult_note: R (Breath of Life) heals allies around him and removes their crowd control, so it can undo a gank or an engage built on stuns. Saving CC until after he uses it, or catching his carry away from him, are options.

key_note: Double Up (Q) bounces off its first target to hit whoever is behind it, so stay out of the area behind low-health minions. She has no dash, so she's easy to gank if she pushes up.

spike_note: Strong early with Double Up poke and a big jump at level 6, when Bullet Time can win fights around objectives; she's at her best in the mid game.

key_note: E (Nimbus Strike) is his gap-closer, and W (Warrior Trickster) turns him invisible and leaves a clone to fake you out or dodge. Trading right after W is used, when he can't hide, is the safer window.
ult_note: R (Cyclone) spins his staff around him while he gains speed, knocking up every enemy it hits. Combined with W invisibility he can reach a grouped team; spreading out and keeping distance from him limit how many get knocked up.

spike_note: Strong in long trades from the start, with a big jump at level 6 when he can isolate a target; with a couple of items he becomes a very hard late-game threat to kill.
